1594-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Helm of Awakening, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2363-4659-5224-7183.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Gathering Stone, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1981-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-5789.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-1981-3330.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-3330.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1115-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

529-4186-4785-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

206-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-3249-4549-5173.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

560-4550-5686-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5686-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Repeat.

1308-2034-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-2034-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

640-5319-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-5319-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Messenger.
Geralf's Messenger dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Messenger, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-2335-7325.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Resolve the Barrenton Medic ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

662-2388-6587-7012.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
662-2388-6587-7012.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3000-3899-4552-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

11-121-2104-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-2104-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Manipulation from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2811-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-413-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Highspire Artisan ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1940-5256-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1940-5256-6249--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3617-4125-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Shipwreck Dowser each turn.
3617-4125-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Shipwreck Dowser by paying its mana cost.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Shipwreck Dowser from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1545-2034-4417-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
1545-2034-4417-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Unstoppable Slasher's toughness.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2} and 2 life, removing both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher and giving Hex Parasite +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2403-2760-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
2403-2760-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1203-5644-5755.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by paying {1}{B}{R} and an amount of life equal to your life total minus 1, targeting any creature.
Judith triggers, giving Fire Covenant deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Fire Covenant, dealing damage equal to the life paid to the targeted creature and causing you to gain that much life.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, dealing that much damage to target opponent.

942-1082-4191.description:
Cast Samwise the Stouthearted by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Samwise the Stouthearted trigger, returning nothing to your hand from your graveyard, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted.
Put the nontoken Samwise the Stouthearted into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers as well as the Samwise the Stouthearted token's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Samwise the Stouthearted trigger, returning the nontoken Samwise the Stouthearted to your hand from your graveyard, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, exiling the Samwise the Stouthearted token.
Repeat.

1487-2073-3390-4647.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Chimeric Mass from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero charge counters on it.
Activate Chimeric Mass by paying {1}, causing it to become a 0/0 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
Chimeric Mass dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Salvaging Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the second Salvaging Station trigger from step 4, untapping it.
Repeat.

112-2104-2304.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling an instant or sorcery at random from your graveyard, and casting a copy of Temporal Manipulation without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

889-1018-3603-4050.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Skullwinder.
Skullwinder enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand and causing target opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2232-2459-4336-5180.notablePrerequisites: Cinder Pyromancer does not have summoning sickness.
2232-2459-4336-5180.description:
Activate Cinder Pyromancer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target player.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep for {0}.
Cinder Pyromancer triggers, untapping itself.
Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Cinder Pyromancer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target player.
Cast Rograkh for {0}.
Cinder Pyromancer triggers, untapping itself.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

637-5147-5173-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Gast.
Mortuary, Shambling Ghast and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shambling Ghast on top of your library.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Shambling Ghast from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.
